output.why: Increasing the COT/DOT waste water transfer pump capacity from 2 m3/hr to 5 m3/hr reduces the emptying time of the 1 m3 collection sump (E1C) from 30 minutes to 12 minutes and increases friction losses across the 144 m long 50NB discharge line. Although 5 m3/hr (~0.71 m/s in 50NB pipe) is well within the 2.4 m/s velocity limit and the 25 m3/hr capacity of the receiving TG Unit-1B sump (E1B), the pump head, motor rating (Electrical Load List), and sump level control setpoints must be reviewed.
